disclaimer: ESTIMATED RULES. These acquisition-program parameters are best-effort from public reporting (Apple.ca, carrier and retailer pages, iphoneincanada / mobilesyrup / planhub, Sept 2026). Terms change often. Every composed option is tagged verify:true. Confirm each rule against the source before showing a number to a user. Refresh monthly.

programs.label: Buy outright + BYOD plan
notes: Own it day one, resell any time, switch plans any time.
Costco / Best Buy gift-card bundles typically knock 3-5% off the device vs the manufacturer's full price.

programs.label: Carrier device financing (24 mo, 0%) + premium plan
notes: 0% interest: total device cost equals retail. The value is keeping the cash and getting the carrier's core network + (business accounts) priority support.
Device bill credit is tied to staying on the premium plan for the term; the plan reverts to full price after.

programs.label: Bring-It-Back / device return (24 mo) + premium plan
notes: Lower monthly because a deferred amount (~350-450) sits at month 24 - pay it to own, or return the device in good working condition.
Return condition is strict: damage or excess wear is charged the gap to a lower trade-in value.
Only competitive if you genuinely replace the device every ~24 months.

programs.label: Best Buy 'no interest if paid in full' (18 mo)
notes: 0% only if the balance clears within the 18-month term - otherwise deferred interest is backdated to the purchase date.
Needs the Best Buy financing card (a credit application).

programs.label: Retailer equal-payments plan (The Brick / Leon's, ~24 mo)
notes: 'Don't pay for a year' / equal monthly payments - 0% only if paid within the term.
~100 admin fee; a credit application is required.

programs.label: Apple Certified Refurbished + BYOD
notes: Full 1-year Apple warranty, new battery and outer shell, same return policy as new.
Typically one generation behind on the current flagship; the pure-value pick if you don't need the newest silicon.

programs.label: Amazon Renewed
notes: Inspected and tested by a qualified supplier; 90-day 'Renewed Guarantee' return.
Condition and battery health vary by seller and by grade - read the listing before buying; a current-flagship renewed discount is usually thinner than this estimate.
No manufacturer warranty unless the listing states otherwise.
